achievements.name: Descent From Avernus
achievements.description: Take control of the nautiloid and escape the Hells.

achievements.name: The Plot Thickens
achievements.description: Leave Act 1 for somewhere altogether darker.

achievements.name: The City Awaits
achievements.description: Leave Act 2.

achievements.name: All's Well That Ends Well
achievements.description: Finish the game.

achievements.name: Absolute Power Corrupts
achievements.description: Reach the ending where you take control of the Netherbrain for yourself.

achievements.name: Hero of the Forgotten Realms
achievements.description: Reach the ending that destroys the Absolute for good - kill the Netherbrain and destroy the tadpoles.

achievements.name: Sins of the Father
achievements.description: As the Dark Urge, reach the ending where you take control of the Netherbrain for Bhaal.

achievements.name: Ceremorphosis
achievements.description: Become a mind flayer to defeat the Netherbrain.

achievements.name: Roleplayer
achievements.description: Complete ten background goals in a single playthrough - you are one with your character.

achievements.name: Bedrolls and Breakfast
achievements.description: Take four full Long Rests in a single playthrough - adventuring's tiring work.

achievements.name: Expand Your Mind
achievements.description: Consume a parasite.

achievements.name: Dig for Victory
achievements.description: Dig up five buried chests in a single playthrough - treasure!

achievements.name: No Penny Required
achievements.description: Successfully use Detect Thoughts to pry into someone's thoughts.

achievements.name: Escapologist
achievements.description: Break out of prison after being arrested - aren't you daring?

achievements.name: Outsourcing
achievements.description: Recruit a hireling. You can befriend them or use them as cannon-fodder - we won't judge.

achievements.name: Jack-of-all-Trades
achievements.description: Multiclass into every class in one playthrough without asking Withers to change your character.

achievements.name: Homebrewer
achievements.description: Create three unique alchemical solutions in a single playthrough - bottoms up!

achievements.name: You Have Two Hands for a Reason
achievements.description: Pet Scratch and the Owlbear Cub at camp at the same time.

achievements.name: Rude, Crude, and Full of Attitude
achievements.description: Find and summon the quasit Shovel.

achievements.name: Forged in Blood and Fire
achievements.description: Craft an item at the Adamantine Forge.

achievements.name: Under Lock and Key
achievements.description: Rescue every prisoner from Moonrise Towers.

achievements.name: She Cannot Be Caged!
achievements.description: Rescue Sazza from three different locations in one playthrough.

achievements.name: Taking Blood
achievements.description: Claim the Blood of Lathander from Rosymorn Monastery.

achievements.name: Leave No One Behind
achievements.description: Save every tiefling refugee in a single playthrough.

achievements.name: Murder in Baldur's Gate
achievements.description: Become an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal.

achievements.name: Mind Blown
achievements.description: Romance the Emperor.

achievements.name: Kill Two Birds With One Gnome
achievements.description: Use one enemy as an improvised weapon against another.

achievements.name: Busker
achievements.description: Earn a hundred gold from playing sweet, sweet music in a single playthrough.

achievements.name: Action Surge
achievements.description: Perform five attacks in one turn. Your enemies won't know what hit them (literally).

achievements.name: Fists of Fury
achievements.description: Kill a character with an Unarmed Strike.

achievements.name: Devil's in the Details
achievements.description: Defeat Commander Zhalk on the nautiloid.

achievements.name: Pest Control
achievements.description: Kill the Spider Matriarch before her eggs hatch.

achievements.name: A Grym Fate
achievements.description: Kill the Adamantine Golem without using the forge hammer.

achievements.name: Non-Invasive Procedure
achievements.description: Kill the Surgeon before he performs surgery on you in combat.

achievements.name: Penny Pincher
achievements.description: Defeat the Toll Collector without her using gold against you - excellent budgeting.

achievements.name: No Free Lunches
achievements.description: Defeat the Apostle of Myrkul before consuming any necromites.

achievements.name: Fancy Footwork
achievements.description: Defeat Gortash in Wyrm's Rock without activating any traps.

achievements.name: First Blood
achievements.description: Kill Orin the Red during the ritual.

achievements.name: Interfectorem Draconis
achievements.description: Kill the red dragon in the Upper City.

achievements.name: Crash Landing
achievements.description: In the Wyrmway, wait until the dragon is mid-flight, then knock it out of the sky - KAPOW.

achievements.name: Bottoms Up
achievements.description: Long Rest using only alcohol - a time-honoured dwarven tradition.

achievements.name: Shove Off
achievements.description: Kill a creature with falling damage.

achievements.name: Bookworm
achievements.description: Read 100 different books in a single playthrough. Adventuring isn't just daring quests, you know.

achievements.name: Punch Drunk
achievements.description: Defeat twenty opponents while drunk - down them.

achievements.name: Fetch Quest
achievements.description: Play fetch with Scratch - the best boy in the Realms.

achievements.name: Repairing the Weave
achievements.description: Stabilise Gale's Netherese orb.

achievements.name: The Lich-Queen's Wrath
achievements.description: Side with Voss against the Githyanki queen Vlaakith.

achievements.name: To Bloom in Darkest Night
achievements.description: Give Shadowheart a Night Orchid.

achievements.name: Hot Date
achievements.description: Go on a date with Karlach.

achievements.name: Just a Nibble
achievements.description: Let Astarion feed on you.

achievements.name: Loophole
achievements.description: Break Wyll's pact with Mizora.

achievements.name: Embrace Your Urge
achievements.description: As the Dark Urge, become the Slayer.

achievements.name: Critical Hit
achievements.description: Complete the game in Tactician mode.

achievements.name: Foehammer
achievements.description: Complete the game in Honour mode.
